title: Surreal Desert Oracle
description: A surreal desert landscape features a cracked earth road leading through orange sand dunes under a massive glowing red sun. In the sky, the head and shoulders of a woman with closed eyes emerge from swirling floral and vine patterns, while a large ornate mechanical device with concentric glowing red and blue circles stands on a post in the foreground.
prompt: Surreal desert scene with cracked dry earth path winding through orange sand dunes. A giant glowing red sun dominates the sky. From swirling dark floral vines and clouds emerges the head of a serene woman with closed eyes and flowing hair. In the foreground stands an ornate circular mechanical device on a metal post featuring glowing concentric rings with a red center. Dreamlike symbolic atmosphere, detailed textures, cinematic lighting.
